title: Anion dependent self-assembly of a linear hexanuclear Yb(III) salen complex with enhanced near-infrared (NIR) luminescence properties

synthesis.procedure: All reactions were performed under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen using standard Schlenk techniques. A solution of Yb(CF3SO3)3 (0.0930 g, 0.15 mmol) in EtOH (10 ml) was added to a solution of H2L (0.0811 g, 0.30 mmol) in MeOH (10 ml). The mixture was stirred and heated under reflux for 2 h; the color changed from pale yellow to brown. After cooling to room temperature and filtration, diethyl ether was allowed to diffuse slowly into the solution at room temperature, giving dark yellow single crystals in one month. The main text reports the same transformation from H2L and Yb(CF3SO3)3 in refluxing MeOH–EtOH (1:1) in 35% yield, without reagent quantities.
synthesis.time: 2 h reflux; crystallization over one month
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk technique under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen; reflux followed by diethyl ether vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature, filtered, and crystallized by slow diethyl ether diffusion at room temperature to give dark yellow single crystals in one month.

properties.summary: Complex 1 shows typical Yb(III) NIR emission (2F5/2 → 2F7/2) upon ligand-centered excitation, together with residual salen-centered visible emission near 480 nm. Under matched absorbance at 275 nm, its relative NIR intensity at 979 nm is 5.1 in CH3CN and 4.2 in CH3OH, higher than complexes 2 and 3; the methanol quench is not more than 20%.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same Schlenk procedure as complex 1 under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen, using Yb(OAc)3·4H2O (0.0633 g, 0.15 mmol) in EtOH (10 ml) added to H2L (0.0811 g, 0.30 mmol) in MeOH (10 ml), refluxed for 2 h, cooled, filtered, and crystallized by slow diethyl ether diffusion at room temperature. Pale yellow single crystals formed in one month. The main text reports formation from H2L and Yb(OAc)3·4H2O under similar MeOH–EtOH reflux conditions in 40% yield, without quantities.
synthesis.time: 2 h reflux; crystallization over one month
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk technique under dry oxygen-free dinitrogen; same reflux and diethyl ether vapor diffusion as complex 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature, filtered, and crystallized by slow diethyl ether diffusion to give pale yellow single crystals in one month.

properties.summary: Complex 3 shows Yb(III) NIR emission (2F5/2 → 2F7/2) and residual salen-centered emission near 480 nm, but the weakest NIR output of the series. Its relative intensity at 979 nm falls from 1.0 in CH3CN to 0.35 in CH3OH, a 65% reduction attributed to poorer shielding of the metal centers.
